blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 35-year-old man who is on probation was arrested on Tuesday after allegedly harassing and threatening two female employees of the Regional Trial Court (RTC) in Los Baños, Laguna. The suspect had visited RTC Branch 107 to inquire about the status of his motion seeking release of his cash bond, the Calabarzon police said on Wednesday. The two court employees informed him to follow the prescribed procedures, which reportedly angered the man. He then approached the employees and allegedly hurled threats and insults at them.
